proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord (SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord). The taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom but types.ts has no corresponding record type or mechanics family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Potion, Rarity Varies — the item kind is magic_item, which has no UnitRecord variant

proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
proposed_widenings.justification: The potion's core mechanic is setting the drinker's Strength score to a fixed value for a timed duration. No effect atom for setting/overriding an ability score exists in v4. The TAXONOMY explicitly defers this: 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state (currently treated as out-of-scope)'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes for 1 hour. The type of giant determines the score (21/23/25/27/29).

proposed_widenings.name: conditional_no_effect_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The potion has a conditional no-effect clause: 'The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.' This is a pre-activation guard comparing current ability score to threshold — no existing surface type or atom models this check.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no MagicItemRecord kind in UnitRecord. Secondary blocker is the missing modify_ability_score effect atom (explicitly deferred in taxonomy v4 as out-of-scope). A tertiary gap is the conditional no-effect guard on current ability score. All three gaps must be resolved before this unit can be honestly encoded.
